title: CollaborationWorkControl
description: Per-work generation and rejection state. generation is incremented only inside the rejection transaction. rerun_authorization_ref stores a rerun grant only; this table neither stores nor implies any commit authorization.

blocked_after_rejection.description: True from the rejection commit until a different work generation is reached. A rerun grant does not clear it.

control_version.description: Optimistic-lock version of this control row; every trusted update increments it.

rerun_authorization_ref.description: grant_id of the rerun grant written by the trusted re-authorization transaction; never a commit grant.

last_candidate_ref.description: artifact_id of the most recent candidate for this work, or null before the first candidate.
